# Face-to-face bargaining analysis

## Load libraries

```{r}

library(tidyverse)
```

## Load data

```{r}

typeSelect <- "derivative"
modelSelect <- "OpenGraphAU"
signalSelect <- "AU6_AU12"

# ---------------------------- DATA SUMMARY ---------------------------

dataDTW <- readRDS("../Datasets/dataDTW.rds") %>%
  dplyr::filter(type == typeSelect & model == modelSelect & signal == signalSelect)

dataSmiles <- readRDS("../Datasets/dataSignals.rds") %>%
  dplyr::filter(model == modelSelect & signal == signalSelect)

dataSignals <- full_join(dataDTW, dataSmiles, by = "dyadID", suffix = c("DTW", ""))

dataF2F <- readRDS("../Datasets/dataF2F.rds") %>%
  mutate(
    fixedEffectsID = paste0(session, player, match),
    openingDistance = openingOffer + opponentOpeningOffer - 18,
    dyadID = interaction(session, round, group, drop = TRUE),
    conflictLow = 1 - conflictHigh,
    conceded = ifelse(agreement==1 & roundPayoff < 9000, 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(session, player, match) %>%
  arrange(round, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    owed = ifelse(round %% 2 == 0 & first(roundPayoff) > 9000, 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(fixedEffectsID) %>%
  mutate(
    stratumEventTime = ifelse(
      max(agreement)==1, # At least one round of the match ended in agreement
      min(roundTime),    # Time of the first event in the risk set (match)
      NA
    ),
    eventRound = ifelse(
      !is.na(stratumEventTime),
      as.numeric(roundTime == stratumEventTime),
      NA
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(., dataSignals, by=join_by(session, player, opponent, dyadID, round)) %>%
  mutate(
    sync=-as.numeric(scale(valueDTW)),
    logSync=-log(valueDTW),
    pseudoSync=-as.numeric(scale(pseudo)),
    logPseudoSync=-log(pseudo),
    smile = if(signalSelect == "AU6_AU12") value / sqrt(2) * 10 else value * 10, # Normalize
    opponentSmile = if(signalSelect == "AU6_AU12") opponentValue * 10 else opponentValue / sqrt(2) * 10, # Normalize
    meanSmile = (smile + opponentSmile) / 2,
    logTime = log(roundTime),
    roundTime10s = roundTime/10
  )

# ------------------------------ DATA LONG ---------------------------------

dataLongDTW <- readRDS("../Datasets/dataLongDTW.rds") %>%
  dplyr::filter(type == typeSelect & model == modelSelect & signal == signalSelect)

dataSmilesLong <- readRDS("../Datasets/dataSignalsLong.rds") %>%
  dplyr::filter(model == modelSelect & signal == signalSelect) %>%
  left_join(dataSmiles, by=c("session", "player", "opponent", "dyadID", "round", "model", "signal"))

by <- join_by(dyadID, startTime, endTime, agreement)

dataSignalsLong <- full_join(dataLongDTW, dataSmilesLong, by = by, suffix = c("DTW", ""))

dataLongF2F <- readRDS("../Datasets/dataF2F.rds") %>%
  mutate(
    fixedEffectsID = paste0(session, player, match),
    openingDistance = openingOffer + opponentOpeningOffer - 18,
    dyadID = interaction(session, round, group, drop = TRUE),
    conflictLow = 1 - conflictHigh,
    conceded = ifelse(agreement==1 & roundPayoff < 9000, 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  group_by(session, player, match) %>%
  arrange(round, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    owed = ifelse(round %% 2 == 0 & first(roundPayoff) > 9000, 1, 0)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(fixedEffectsID) %>%
  mutate(
    stratumEventTime = ifelse(
      max(agreement)==1, # At least one round of the match ended in agreement
      min(roundTime),    # Time of the first event in the risk set (match)
      NA
    ),
    eventRound = ifelse(
      !is.na(stratumEventTime),
      as.numeric(roundTime == stratumEventTime),
      NA
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-c(agreement, roundStart, roundEnd)) %>%
  left_join(., dataSignalsLong, by=join_by(session, player, opponent, dyadID, round)) %>%
  mutate(
    sync=-as.numeric(scale(valueEMADTW)),
    logSync=-log(valueEMADTW),
    pseudoSync=-as.numeric(scale(pseudo)),
    logPseudoSync=-log(pseudo),
    smile = if(signalSelect == "AU6_AU12") value / sqrt(2) * 10 else value * 10, # Normalize
    opponentSmile = if(signalSelect == "AU6_AU12") opponentValue * 10 else opponentValue / sqrt(2) * 10, # Normalize
    meanSmile = (value + opponentValue) / 2,
    period = cut(
      endTime,
      breaks = c(-Inf, 10, 30, Inf),
      labels = c("early", "middle", "late")
    ),
    logTime = log(roundTime),
    roundTime10s = roundTime/10
  )

dataConstants <- readRDS("../Datasets/dataConstants.rds")
```

## CFA

### Congenial measurement

```{r}

fixedMeasurementFun <- function(i, parameterTable, digits=10) {
  
  lhs <- parameterTable[i, "lhs"]
  
  par <- round(parameterTable[i,"est"], digits = digits)
  
  if (parameterTable[i,"op"] == "~1") {
    string <- paste(lhs, "~", par, "*", 1)
    return(string)
  } else {
    string <- paste(lhs, parameterTable[i, "op"], par, "*", parameterTable[i, "rhs"])
    return(string)
  }
}

extraMeasurementFun <- function(lvNames, covariates, binary, data) {
  
  extraMeasurement <- paste(
    c(
      paste0(lvNames, " ~~ ", paste(covariates, collapse= " + "), " \n "),
      paste0(
        covariates[-length(covariates)], " ~~ ", 
        sapply(
          seq_len(length(covariates) - 1), 
          function(i) {
            paste(covariates[(i+1):length(covariates)], collapse=" + ")
          }
        ), 
        " \n "
      )
    ),
    collapse=""
  )
  
  binaryStrings <- sapply(
    binary,
    function(j) {
      sampleAverage <- mean(data[[j]], na.rm=TRUE)
      sampleVariance <- sampleAverage * (1 - sampleAverage)
      
      string <- paste(
        paste(j, "~",  sampleAverage, "*1"),
        paste(j, "~~", sampleVariance, "*", j),
        sep = "\n"
      )
      return(string)
    }
  )
  
  return(paste(extraMeasurement, paste(binaryStrings, collapse = " \n "), sep=" \n "))
}


congenialCoxFun <- function(measurementFit, idCols, longCols, covariates, binary, data, dataLong) {
  
  dataFit <- lavInspect(measurementFit, "data")
  
  caseIndices <- lavInspect(measurementFit, "case.idx")
  
  dataIDs <- cbind(
    dataFit,
    data[caseIndices, idCols]
  )
  
  dataFit <- data[, c(idCols, covariates)] %>%
    right_join(
      dataIDs,
      by=idCols
    )
  
  dataLongFit <- dataLong[, c(idCols, longCols, covariates)] %>%
    group_by(fixedEffectsID) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      startTime < stratumEventTime & stratumEventTime <= endTime
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    right_join(
      dataIDs,
      by=idCols
    )
  
  parameterTable <- parameterEstimates(measurementFit)
  
  fixedMeasurementBlock <- sapply(
    X = 1:nrow(parameterTable),
    FUN = fixedMeasurementFun,
    parameterTable = parameterTable,
    digits=10
  ) %>%
    paste(collapse = " \n ")  
  
  lvNames <- lavNames(measurementFit, type = "lv")
  
  expandedModel <- paste(
    fixedMeasurementBlock,
    extraMeasurementFun(lvNames, covariates, binary, dataFit),
    sep = "\n"
  )
  
  expandedModelLong <- paste(
    fixedMeasurementBlock,
    extraMeasurementFun(lvNames, covariates, binary, dataLongFit),
    sep = "\n"
  )
  
  congenialFit <- cfa(
    expandedModel,  
    estimator = "ML",
    missing = "fiml",
    meanstructure = TRUE,
    std.lv = FALSE,
    se = "none",
#    cluster = "clusterID",
    data = dataFit
  )
  
  congenialLongFit <- cfa(
    expandedModelLong,  
    estimator = "ML",
    missing = "fiml",
    meanstructure = TRUE,
    std.lv = FALSE,
    se = "none",
#    cluster = "clusterID",
    data = dataLongFit
  )
  
  return(
    list(
    congenial     = congenialFit,
    data          = dataFit,
    congenialLong = congenialLongFit,
    dataLong      = dataLongFit
    )
  )
}

congenialLinearFun <- function(measurementFit, idCols, longCols, covariates, binary, data, dataLong) {
  
  dataFit <- lavInspect(measurementFit, "data")
  
  caseIndices <- lavInspect(measurementFit, "case.idx")
  
  dataIDs <- cbind(
    dataFit,
    data[caseIndices, idCols]
  )
  
  dataFit <- data[, c(idCols, covariates)] %>%
    right_join(
      dataIDs,
      by=idCols
    )
  
  dataLongFit <- dataLong[, c(idCols, longCols, covariates)] %>%
    group_by(session, player, round) %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      endTime == max(endTime)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    right_join(
      dataIDs,
      by=idCols
    )
  
  parameterTable <- parameterEstimates(measurementFit)
  
  fixedMeasurementBlock <- sapply(
    X = 1:nrow(parameterTable),
    FUN = fixedMeasurementFun,
    parameterTable = parameterTable,
    digits=10
  ) %>%
    paste(collapse = " \n ")  
  
  lvNames <- lavNames(measurementFit, type = "lv")
  
  expandedModel <- paste(
    fixedMeasurementBlock,
    extraMeasurementFun(lvNames, covariates, binary, dataFit),
    sep = "\n"
  )
  
  expandedModelLong <- paste(
    fixedMeasurementBlock,
    extraMeasurementFun(lvNames, covariates, binary, dataLongFit),
    sep = "\n"
  )
  
  congenialFit <- cfa(
    expandedModel,  
    estimator = "ML",
    missing = "fiml",
    meanstructure = TRUE,
    std.lv = FALSE,
    se = "none",
    #    cluster = "clusterID",
    data = dataFit
  )
  
  congenialLongFit <- cfa(
    expandedModelLong,  
    estimator = "ML",
    missing = "fiml",
    meanstructure = TRUE,
    std.lv = FALSE,
    se = "none",
    #    cluster = "clusterID",
    data = dataLongFit
  )
  
  return(
    list(
      congenial     = congenialFit,
      data          = dataFit,
      congenialLong = congenialLongFit,
      dataLong      = dataLongFit
    )
  )
}
```

### Congenial draw

```{r}

plausibleDrawFun <- function(measurementFit) {
  
  factorScores <- lavPredict(
    measurementFit,
    method = "regression",
    acov = "standard",
    transform = FALSE
  )
  
  dataPatterns <- lavInspect(measurementFit, "data") 
  dataPatterns <- 1L * !is.na(dataPatterns)
  
  patterns <- lavInspect(measurementFit, "patterns")
  
  patternVec <- integer(nrow(dataPatterns))
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(patterns))) {
    rowMatches <- rowSums(
      abs(sweep(dataPatterns, 2, patterns[i, ], FUN = "-"))
    ) == 0
    
    patternVec[rowMatches] <- i
  }
  
  stopifnot(
    length(patternVec) == nrow(factorScores),
    all(patternVec > 0L)
  )
  
  acov <- attr(factorScores, "acov")[[1]]
  
  plausibleDraw <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(
      seq_len(nrow(factorScores)),
      function(i) {
        drop(
          mnormt::rmnorm(
            n = 1,
            mean = factorScores[i, ],
            varcov = acov[[patternVec[i]]]
          )
        )
      }
    )
  )
  
  colnames(plausibleDraw) <- colnames(factorScores)
  
  return(plausibleDraw)
}
```

## Plausible functions

### Process

```{r}

plausibleProcessFun <- function(plausibleFit) {
  
  processed <- plausibleFit %>%
    group_by(Response, Model, Type, Panel, Term) %>%
    summarise(
      M = n(),
      Estimate = if (
        first(Panel) == "Coefficients" ||
        first(Term) %in% c("Concordance", "Nagelkerke R2", "R2")
      ) {
        mean(coef, na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        first(coef)
      },
      WithinVar = if (first(Panel) == "Coefficients") {
        mean(se^2, na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      BetweenVar = if (first(Panel) == "Coefficients") {
        var(coef, na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      TotalVar = ifelse(Panel == "Coefficients", WithinVar + (1 + 1/M) * BetweenVar, NA),
      SE = ifelse(Panel == "Coefficients", sqrt(TotalVar), NA),
      Z = ifelse(Panel == "Coefficients", Estimate / SE, NA),
      P = ifelse(Panel == "Coefficients", 2 * pnorm(abs(Z), lower.tail = FALSE), NA)
    )
  
  return(processed)
}
```

### Cox

```{r}

coxExtractor <- function(data, predictors, varying = FALSE) {
  
  modelVariables <- predictors[
    !grepl("^(strata|cluster|tt)\\(", predictors)
  ]
  
  used <- data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      if_all(all_of(modelVariables), ~ !is.na(.x))
    )
  
  if ("strata(fixedEffectsID)" %in% predictors) {
    
    used <- used %>%
      group_by(fixedEffectsID)
    
    if (varying) {
      used <- used %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          startTime < stratumEventTime,
          stratumEventTime <= endTime
        )
    }
    
    used <- used %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        any(agreement == 1),
        n() == 2
      ) %>%
      ungroup()
    
    return(
      list(
        risk = n_distinct(
          used$session,
          used$player,
          used$round
        ),
        strata = n_distinct(used$fixedEffectsID),
        clusters = n_distinct(used$clusterID)
      )
    )
  }
  
  list(
    risk = n_distinct(
      used$session,
      used$player,
      used$round
    ),
    strata = 1L,
    clusters = n_distinct(used$clusterID)
  )
}
  

plausibleCoxFun <- function(draw, predictors, timeFun, measurementList, modelName, data, dataLong = NULL, masterSeed) {
  
  set.seed(masterSeed + draw)
  
  PVs <- plausibleDrawFun(measurementList[["congenial"]])
  
  indices <- lavInspect(measurementList[["congenial"]], "case.idx")
  
  dataPV <- cbind(
    measurementList[["data"]][indices, c("session", "player", "round")],
    PVs
  ) %>%
    right_join(data, by=c("session", "player", "round"))
  
  syntax <- paste0("Surv(roundTime, agreement) ~ ", paste(predictors, collapse=" + "))
  
  coxFit <- coxph(
    as.formula(syntax),
    data = dataPV,
    ties = "efron",
    tt = timeFun
  )
  
  coxGrouping <- coxExtractor(data=dataPV, predictors=predictors, varying=FALSE)
  nRisk <- coxGrouping[["risk"]]
  nStrata <- coxGrouping[["strata"]]
  nClusters <- coxGrouping[["clusters"]]
  rsq <- summary(coxFit)$rsq
  r2 <- unname(rsq["rsq"] / rsq["maxrsq"])
  
  modelTable <- as.data.frame(summary(coxFit)$coefficients) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Term") %>%
    rename(
      se = `robust se`,
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Response="Agreement",
      Model=modelName,
      Type="Constant",
      Panel="Coefficients"
    ) %>%
    select(Response, Model, Type, Panel, Term, coef, se) %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(
      tibble(
        Response="Agreement",
        Model=modelName,
        Type="Constant",
        Panel="Info",
        Term=c("Concordance", "Nagelkerke R2", "N", "Events", "Strata", "Clusters"),
        coef=c(coxFit$concordance[["concordance"]], r2, nRisk, coxFit$nevent, nStrata, nClusters),
        se=c(coxFit$concordance[["std"]], rep(NA_real_, times=5))
      )
    )
  
  if(!is.null(dataLong)) {
    
    longPVs <- plausibleDrawFun(measurementList[["congenialLong"]])
    
    indicesLong <- lavInspect(measurementList[["congenialLong"]], "case.idx")
    
    dataLongPV <- cbind(
      measurementList[["dataLong"]][indicesLong, c("session", "player", "round")],
      longPVs
    ) %>%
      right_join(dataLong, by=c("session", "player", "round"))
    
    syntaxLong <- paste0("Surv(startTime, endTime, agreement) ~ ", paste(predictors, collapse=" + "))
    
    coxFitLong <- coxph(
      as.formula(syntaxLong),
      data = dataLongPV,
      ties = "efron",
      tt = timeFun
    )
    
    coxGrouping <- coxExtractor(data=dataLongPV, predictors=predictors, varying=TRUE)
    nRisk <- coxGrouping[["risk"]]
    nStrata <- coxGrouping[["strata"]]
    nClusters <- coxGrouping[["clusters"]]
    rsq <- summary(coxFitLong)$rsq
    r2 <- unname(rsq["rsq"] / rsq["maxrsq"])
    
    modelLongTable <- as.data.frame(summary(coxFitLong)$coefficients) %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("Term") %>%
      rename(
        se = `robust se`,
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Response="Agreement",
        Model=modelName,
        Type="Varying",
        Panel="Coefficients"
      ) %>%
      select(Response, Model, Type, Panel, Term, coef, se) %>%
      dplyr::bind_rows(
        tibble(
          Response="Agreement",
          Model=modelName,
          Type="Varying",
          Panel="Info",
          Term=c("Concordance", "Nagelkerke R2", "N", "Events", "Strata", "Clusters"),
          coef=c(coxFitLong$concordance[["concordance"]], r2, nRisk, coxFitLong$nevent, nStrata, nClusters),
          se=c(coxFitLong$concordance[["std"]], rep(NA_real_, times=5))
        )
      )
    
    tableOut <- dplyr::bind_rows(modelTable, modelLongTable)
    return(tableOut)
    
  } else {
    return(modelTable)
  }
}

processCoxFun <- function(coxFit, modelName, type, predictors, data) {
  varying <- type=="Varying"
  coxGrouping <- coxExtractor(data=data, predictors=predictors, varying=varying)
  nRisk <- coxGrouping[["risk"]]
  nStrata <- coxGrouping[["strata"]]
  nClusters <- coxGrouping[["clusters"]]
  rsq <- summary(coxFit)$rsq
  r2 <- unname(rsq["rsq"] / rsq["maxrsq"])
  
  processed <- as.data.frame(summary(coxFit)$coefficients) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Term") %>%
    rename(
      Estimate=coef,
      SE = `robust se`,
      Z = z,
      P = `Pr(>|z|)`
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Response="Agreement",
      Model=modelName,
      Type=type,
      Panel="Coefficients",
    ) %>%
    select(Response, Model, Type, Panel, Term, Estimate, SE, Z, P) %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(
      tibble(
        Response="Agreement",
        Model=modelName,
        Type=type,
        Panel="Info",
        Term=c("Concordance", "Nagelkerke R2", "N", "Events", "Strata", "Clusters"),
        Estimate=c(coxFit$concordance[["concordance"]], r2, nRisk, coxFit$nevent, nStrata, nClusters),
        SE=c(coxFit$concordance[["std"]], rep(NA_real_, times=5)),
        Z=NA_real_,
        P=NA_real_
      )
    )
  
  return(processed)
}
```

### FE

```{r}

plausibleFeolsFun <- function(draw, response, predictors, fixedEffects = 0, cluster, measurementList, modelName, data, dataLong=NULL, masterSeed) {
  
  set.seed(masterSeed + draw)
  
  PVs <- plausibleDrawFun(measurementList[["congenial"]])
  
  indices <- lavInspect(measurementList[["congenial"]], "case.idx")
  
  dataPV <- cbind(
    measurementList[["data"]][indices, c("session", "player", "round")],
    PVs
  ) %>%
    right_join(data, by=c("session", "player", "round"))
  
  syntax <- paste0(response, " ~ ", paste(predictors, collapse=" + "), " | ", fixedEffects)
  
  modelFE<- feols(
    as.formula(syntax),
    cluster = cluster,
    data = dataPV
  )
  
  r2 <- if (fixedEffects == 0) {
    as.numeric(fitstat(modelFE, "r2"))
  } else {
    as.numeric(fitstat(modelFE, "wr2"))
  }
  nClusters <- as.integer(attr(modelFE$cov.scaled, "G"))
  nFE <- if (length(modelFE$fixef_sizes)) {
    unname(modelFE$fixef_sizes[[1]])
  } else {
    0L
  }
  
  modelTable <- as.data.frame(summary(modelFE)$coeftable) %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("Term") %>%
    rename(
      coef = Estimate,
      se = `Std. Error`
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Response=response,
      Model=modelName,
      Type="Constant",
      Panel="Coefficients"
    ) %>%
    select(Response, Model, Type, Panel, Term, coef, se) %>%
    dplyr::bind_rows(
      tibble(
        Response=response,
        Model=modelName,
        Type="Constant",
        Panel="Info",
        Term=c("R2", "N", "FE", "Clusters"),
        coef=c(r2, modelFE$nobs, nFE, nClusters),
        se=NA_real_
      )
    )
  
  if(!is.null(dataLong)) {
    
    longPVs <- plausibleDrawFun(measurementList[["congenialLong"]])
    
    indicesLong <- lavInspect(measurementList[["congenialLong"]], "case.idx")
    
    mask <- c("session", "player", "round", setdiff(colnames(data), colnames(measurementList[["dataLong"]])))
    
    dataLongPV <- cbind(
      measurementList[["dataLong"]][indicesLong, ],
      longPVs
    ) %>%
      left_join(
        data[, mask, drop = FALSE],
        by=c("session", "player", "round")
      )
    
    syntaxLong <- paste0(response, " ~ ", paste(predictors, collapse=" + "), " | ", fixedEffects)
    
    modelLongFE<- feols(
      as.formula(syntaxLong),
      cluster = cluster,
      data = dataLongPV
    )
    
    r2 <- if (fixedEffects == 0) {
      as.numeric(fitstat(modelLongFE, "r2"))
    } else {
      as.numeric(fitstat(modelLongFE, "wr2"))
    }
    nClusters <- as.integer(attr(modelLongFE$cov.scaled, "G"))
    nFE <- if (length(modelLongFE$fixef_sizes)) {
      unname(modelLongFE$fixef_sizes[[1]])
    } else {
      0L
    }
    
    modelLongTable <- as.data.frame(summary(modelLongFE)$coeftable) %>%
      tibble::rownames_to_column("Term") %>%
      rename(
        coef = Estimate,
        se = `Std. Error`
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Response=response,
        Model=modelName,
        Type="Varying",
        Panel="Coefficients"
      ) %>%
      select(Response, Model, Type, Panel, Term, coef, se) %>%
      dplyr::bind_rows(
        tibble(
          Response=response,
          Model=modelName,
          Type="Varying",
          Panel="Info",
          Term=c("R2", "N", "FE", "Clusters"),
          coef=c(r2, modelLongFE$nobs, nFE, nClusters),
          se=NA_real_
        )
      )
    
    tableOut <- dplyr::bind_rows(modelTable, modelLongTable)
    return(tableOut)
    
  } else {
    return(modelTable)
  }
  
}
```

### SEM

```{r}

checkConvergence <- function(fit) {
  isTRUE(lavInspect(fit, "converged")) &&
    isTRUE(lavInspect(fit, "post.check"))
}

demeanFun <- function(data, idVariables, analysisVariables) {
  
  modelVariables <- c(idVariables, analysisVariables)
  
  demeanedData <- data %>%
    dplyr::filter(
      if_all(all_of(modelVariables), ~ !is.na(.x))
    ) %>%
    group_by(fixedEffectsID) %>%
    dplyr::filter(n() == 2) %>%
    mutate(
      across(
        all_of(analysisVariables) & where(is.numeric),
        ~ as.numeric(scale(.x, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE))
      )
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  return(demeanedData)
}

plausibleFunSEM <- function(draw, model, measurementList, demean=FALSE, idVariables, analysisVariables, data, masterSeed) {
  
  set.seed(masterSeed + draw)
  
  PVs <- plausibleDrawFun(measurementList[["congenial"]])
  
  indices <- lavInspect(measurementList[["congenial"]], "case.idx")
  
  dataPV <- cbind(
    measurementList[["data"]][indices, c("session", "player", "round")],
    PVs
  ) %>%
    right_join(data, by=c("session", "player", "round"))
  
  demeanedPV <- if(demean) {
    demeanFun(dataPV, idVariables, analysisVariables)
  } else {
    dataPV
  }
  
  structuralFit <- sem(
    model=model,
    estimator="MLR",
    meanstructure=TRUE,
    cluster = "clusterID",
    data = demeanedPV
  )

  if (!checkConvergence(structuralFit)) return(NULL)
  
  estimates <- parameterEstimates(structuralFit)
  
  r2 <- lavInspect(structuralFit, "r2")
  nobs <- lavInspect(structuralFit, "nobs")
  nFE <- nobs / 2
  nClusters <- structuralFit@Data@Lp[[1]]$nclusters[[2]]
  
  gofRows <- tibble::tibble(
    lhs = rep(names(r2), times = 4),
    op = "gof",
    rhs = rep(c("R2", "N", "FE", "Clusters"), each = length(r2)),
    est = c(
      as.numeric(r2),
      rep(nobs, length(r2)),
      rep(nFE, length(r2)),
      rep(nClusters, length(r2))
    ),
    se = NA_real_,
    z = NA_real_,
    pvalue = NA_real_,
    ci.lower = NA_real_,
    ci.upper = NA_real_
  )

  estimates <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    estimates,
    gofRows,
  )
  
  return(estimates)
}


# -------------------------------- PROCESS RESULTS ------------------------------------

processFunSEM <- function(structuralFit) {
  
  processed <- structuralFit %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(est)) %>%
    group_by(lhs, op, rhs) %>%
    summarise(
      M = n(),
      Estimate = if (!(first(op) == "gof") || first(rhs) == "R2") {
        mean(est, na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        first(est)
      },
      WithinVar = if (!(first(op) == "gof")) {
        mean(se^2, na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      BetweenVar = if (!(first(op) == "gof")) {
        var(est, na.rm = TRUE)
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      TotalVar = ifelse(!(op == "gof"), WithinVar + (1 + 1/M) * BetweenVar, NA),
      SE = ifelse(!(op == "gof"), sqrt(TotalVar), NA),
      Z = ifelse(!(op == "gof"), Estimate / SE, NA),
      P = ifelse(!(op == "gof"), 2 * pnorm(abs(Z), lower.tail = FALSE), NA),
    )
  
  return(processed)
  
}
```

```{r}

    rbind,
    pbmcapply::pbmclapply(
      X = 1:M,
      FUN = plausibleFeolsFun,
      response = response,
      predictors = predictors,
      fixedEffects = 0,
      cluster = "clusterID",
      measurementList = congenialLinearList,
      modelName = "Design",
      data = dataF2F,
      dataLong = dataLongF2F,
      masterSeed = masterSeed,
      mc.cores = 15,
      mc.set.seed = TRUE
    )
  )
} else {
  conflictDesign <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(
      X = 1:M,
      FUN = plausibleFeolsFun,
      response = response,
      predictors = predictors,
      fixedEffects = 0,
      cluster = "clusterID",
      measurementList = congenialLinearList,
      modelName = "Design",
      data = dataF2F,
      dataLong = dataLongF2F,
      masterSeed = masterSeed
    )
  )
}

  dplyr::filter(Type=="Constant")
```

### Print table

```{r}
termLevels <- c(
  "roundTime10s",
  "logSync",
  #  "tt(logSync)",
  "logPseudoSync",
  #  "tt(logPseudoSync)",
  "meanSmile",
  #  "tt(meanSmile)",
  #  "smile",
  #  "tt(smile)",

  "conflictLow",
  "stepSize",
  "secondRound",
  "round",
  "openingDistance",
  "(Intercept)",
  "R2",
  "N",
  "FE",
  "Clusters"
)

termLabels <- c(
  "Round time (10s)",
  "Log smile sync",
  #  "Log smile sync × ln(1+t)",
  "Log pseudo sync",
  #  "Log pseudo sync × ln(1+t)",
  "Mean smile (dyad)",
  #  "Mean smile × ln(1+t)",
  #  "Smile",
  #  "Smile × ln(1+t)",
  #  "Opponent smile",
  #  "Opponent smile × ln(1+t)",
  "Restricted",
  "Step size",
  "Second round",
  "Round",
  "Opening distance",
  "Intercept",
  "R²",
  "N",
  "Fixed effects",
  "Clusters"
)

modelLevels <- c(
  "Design", 
  "Raw",
  "Total",
  "Covariates",
  "Direct"
)

modelLabels <- c(
  "Design", 
  "Raw",
  "Total",
  "Covariates",
  "Direct"
)

conflictTable <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  conflictTableDesign,
  conflictTableRaw,
  conflictTableTotal,
  conflictTableCovariates,
  conflictTableDirect
) %>%
  group_by(Response, Model, Type, Panel, Term) %>%
  mutate(
    stars = case_when(
      P <= 0.001 ~ "***",
      P <= 0.01  ~ "**",
      P <= 0.05  ~ "*",
      .default = ""
    ),
    pFormatted = if_else(
      P < 0.001,
      "&lt;.001",
      paste0("=", sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.3f", P)))
    ),
    Estimate = case_when(
      Panel == "Coefficients" ~ sprintf(
        paste0(
          "%.3f%s",
          "<br><span style='font-size:85%%;'>(%.3f)</span>",
          "<br><span style='font-size:85%%;'>p%s</span>"
        ),
        Estimate, stars, SE, pFormatted
      ),
      Term == "R2" ~ sprintf("%.3f", Estimate),
      .default = sprintf("%.0f", Estimate)
    ),
    Model = factor(
      Model,
      levels = modelLevels,
      labels = modelLabels
    ),
    Panel = factor(
      Panel,
      levels = c("Coefficients", "Info"),
      labels = c("Coefficients", "Model information")
    ),
    Term = factor(
      Term, 
      levels = termLevels,
      labels = termLabels
    )
  )

conflictTable <- conflictTable %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Panel,
    Term,
    Model,
    Estimate
  ) %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = c(Panel, Term),
    names_from = Model,
    values_from = Estimate
  ) %>%
  arrange(Panel, Term)

conflictTable <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  conflictTable %>% dplyr::filter(Panel == "Coefficients"),
  conflictTable %>% dplyr::filter(Panel == "Model information")
) %>%
  dplyr::select(-Panel)
```

## Test identification

```{r}

idVariables <- c(
  "fixedEffectsID",
  "clusterID"
)

analysisVariables <- c(
#  "conflict",
  "SIS_C1",
  "SIS_C2",
  "logTime",
  "roundTime",
  "roundTime10s",
  "conflictLow",
  "stepSize",
  "secondRound"
)

modelVariables <- c(analysisVariables, idVariables)

demeanedData <- dataF2F %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    if_all(all_of(modelVariables), ~ !is.na(.x))
  ) %>%
  group_by(fixedEffectsID) %>%
  dplyr::filter(n() == 2) %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      all_of(analysisVariables) & where(is.numeric),
      ~ as.numeric(scale(.x, center = TRUE, scale = FALSE))
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

### SUR system

```{r}

modelName <- "SUR"

modelSUR <- '
  
  conflict ~ 0*1 + stepSize + secondRound
  
  roundTime10s ~ 0*1 + stepSize + secondRound
  
  conflict ~~ roundTime10s

'

if (parallelSupported) {
  jointSUR <- do.call(
    rbind,
    pbmcapply::pbmclapply(
      X = 1:M,
      FUN = plausibleFunSEM,
      model = modelSUR,
      measurementList = congenialLinearList,
      demean=TRUE,
      idVariables = idVariables,
      analysisVariables = analysisVariables,
      data = dataF2F,
      masterSeed = masterSeed,
      mc.cores = 15,
      mc.set.seed = TRUE
    )
  )
} else {
  jointSUR <- do.call(
    rbind,
    lapply(
      X = 1:M,
      FUN = plausibleFunSEM,
      model = modelSUR,
      measurementList = congenialLinearList,
      demean=TRUE,
      idVariables = idVariables,
      analysisVariables = analysisVariables,
      data = dataF2F,
      masterSeed = masterSeed
    )
  )
}

jointTableSUR <- processFunSEM(jointSUR) %>%
  mutate(model=modelName)

jointTableSUR %>%
  dplyr::select(lhs, op, rhs, Estimate, SE, Z, P) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!(op=="~1")) %>%
  mutate(
    across(c(Estimate, SE, Z, P), \(x) round(x, digits = 4))
  )
```

### 2SLS diagnostics

```{r}

extract2SLS <- function(fit, responseName, modelName = "MIIV-2SLS") {
  
  estimates <- tidy(fit) %>%
    rename(
      rhs = term,
      Estimate = estimate,
      SE = std.error,
      Z = statistic,
      P = p.value
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      lhs = responseName,
      op = "~",
      model = modelName,
      rhs = gsub("`", "", rhs)
    ) %>%
    select(lhs, op, rhs, Estimate, SE, Z, P, model)
  
  r2 <- fit$r.squared
  nobs <- fit$nobs
  nFE <- nobs / 2
  nClusters <- fit$n_clusters
  
  gofRows <- tibble::tibble(
    lhs = responseName,
    op = "gof",
    rhs = c("R2", "N", "FE", "Clusters"),
    Estimate = c(
      as.numeric(r2),
      as.numeric(nobs),
      as.numeric(nFE),
      as.numeric(nClusters)
    ),
    SE = NA_real_,
    Z = NA_real_,
    P = NA_real_,
    model = modelName
  )
  
  estimates <- dplyr::bind_rows(
    estimates,
    gofRows,
  )
  
  return(estimates)
}

extractDiagnostics <- function(fit, responseName) {
  
  instrumentLevels <- c(
    "stepSize",
    "secondRound"
  )
  
  instrumentLabels <- c(
    "Step size",
    "Second round"
  )
  
  testLevels <- c(
    "weak_id_robust",
    "anderson_rubin_f",
    "endogeneity"
  )
  
  testLabels <- c(
    "Kleibergen-Paap",
    "Anderson-Rubin",
    "Endogeneity C-test"
  )
  
  diagnosticsTable <- diagnostics(fit) %>%
    filter(
      test %in% c("weak_id_robust", "anderson_rubin_f", "endogeneity")
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      test = factor(test, levels = testLevels, labels = testLabels),
      pFormatted = if_else(
        p_value < 0.001,
        "&lt;.001",
        paste0("=", sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.3f", p_value)))
      ),
      Estimate = case_when(
        !is.na(df) & !is.na(df2) ~ sprintf(
          "F(%.0f, %.0f)=%.3f<br>p%s",
          df, df2, statistic, pFormatted
        ),
        !is.na(df) ~ sprintf(
          "&chi;&sup2;(%.0f)=%.3f<br>p%s",
          df, statistic, pFormatted
        ),
        .default = sprintf("%.0f", statistic)
      ),
      .keep = "none"
    ) %>%
    select(-pFormatted) %>%
    pivot_wider(
      names_from = test,
      values_from = Estimate
    )

  out <- cbind(
    tibble(
      Outcome = responseName,
      Instrument = fit$instruments,
      `Partial-R²` = sprintf("%.3f", fit$first_stage[[fit$endogenous]]$partial_r2)
    ),
    diagnosticsTable
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      Instrument = factor(Instrument, levels = instrumentLevels, labels = instrumentLabels)
    )
  
  return(out)
}
```

```{r}

conflict2SLS <- ivreg2(
  SIS_C1 ~ 0 + stepSize | roundTime10s | secondRound,
  data = demeanedData,
  method = "2sls",
  clusters = ~clusterID,
  small = TRUE,
  dofminus = n_distinct(demeanedData$fixedEffectsID),
  endog = "roundTime10s",
  first_stage = TRUE
)

summary(conflict2SLS)

time2SLS <- ivreg2(
  roundTime10s ~ 0 + secondRound | SIS_C1 | stepSize,
  data = demeanedData,
  method = "2sls",
  clusters = ~clusterID,
  small = TRUE,
  dofminus = n_distinct(demeanedData$fixedEffectsID),
  endog = "SIS_C1",
  first_stage = TRUE
)

summary(time2SLS)


# 1. Extract structural coefficients
jointTableConflict2SLS <- extract2SLS(conflict2SLS, responseName = "conflict")
jointTableTime2SLS <- extract2SLS(time2SLS, responseName = "roundTime10s")

jointTable2SLS <- dplyr::bind_rows(jointTableConflict2SLS, jointTableTime2SLS)


# 2. Extract diagnostics
diagnosticsConflict2SLS <- extractDiagnostics(conflict2SLS, responseName = "Conflict &larr; Time")
diagnosticsTime2SLS <- extractDiagnostics(time2SLS, responseName = "Time &larr; Conflict")

diagnostics2SLS <- dplyr::bind_rows(diagnosticsConflict2SLS, diagnosticsTime2SLS)
```

### Print table

```{r}

outcomeLevels <- c(
  "conflict",
  "roundTime10s"
)

outcomeLabels <- c(
  "Conflict",
  "Time"
)

termLevels <- c(
  "conflict",
  "roundTime10s",
  "stepSize",
  "secondRound",
  "residual",
  "R2",
  "N",
  "FE",
  "Clusters"
)

termLabels <- c(
  "Conflict",
  "Time",
  "Step size",
  "Second round",
  "Residual cov.",
  "R²",
  "N",
  "Fixed effects",
  "Clusters"
)

modelLevels <- c("SUR", "Univariate", "Triangular", "Simultaneous", "MIIV-2SLS")
modelLabels <- c("SUR", "Univariate", "Triangular", "Simultaneous", "MIIV-2SLS")

identificationTable <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  jointTableSUR,
  jointTableUnivariate,
  jointTableTriangular,
  jointTableSimultaneous,
  jointTable2SLS
) %>%
  filter(
    op %in% c("~", "gof")
    | (lhs != rhs & lhs %in% outcomeLevels & rhs %in% outcomeLevels)
  )

residualRows <- identificationTable %>%
  filter(op == "~~") %>%
  mutate(
    temp = lhs,
    lhs = rhs,
    rhs = temp
  ) %>%
  select(-temp)
  
identificationTable <- dplyr::bind_rows(identificationTable, residualRows) %>%
  mutate(
    rhs = ifelse(op == "~~", "residual", rhs),
    rhs = ifelse(rhs == "SIS_C1", "conflict", rhs)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    stars = case_when(
      P <= 0.001 ~ "***",
      P <= 0.01  ~ "**",
      P <= 0.05  ~ "*",
      .default = ""
    ),
    pFormatted = if_else(
      P < 0.001,
      "&lt;.001",
      paste0("=", sub("^0", "", sprintf("%.3f", P)))
    ),
    Estimate = case_when(
      op %in% c("~", "~~") ~ sprintf(
        "%.3f%s<br>(%.3f)<br>p%s",
        Estimate, stars, SE, pFormatted
      ),
      rhs == "R2" ~ sprintf("%.3f", Estimate),
      .default = sprintf("%.0f", Estimate)
    ),
    Outcome = factor(
      lhs,
      levels = outcomeLevels,
      labels = outcomeLabels
    ),
    Model = factor(
      model,
      levels = modelLevels,
      labels = modelLabels
    ),
    Panel = factor(
      case_when(
        op %in% c("~", "~~") ~ "Coefficients",
        op == "gof" ~ "Model information",
        .default = ""
      ),
      levels = c("Coefficients", "Model information")
    ),
    Term = factor(
      rhs, 
      levels = termLevels,
      labels = termLabels
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Outcome,
    Term,
    Model,
    Estimate,
    Panel
  )

identificationTable <- identificationTable %>%
  tidyr::pivot_wider(
    id_cols = Term,
    names_from = c(Model, Outcome),
    values_from = Estimate,
    names_sep = "_",
    names_expand = FALSE
  ) %>%
  arrange(Term)

identificationGT <- identificationTable %>%
  gt::gt(
    rowname_col = "Term"
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_spanner_delim(
    delim = "_"
  ) %>%
  gt::fmt_markdown(
    columns = everything()
  ) %>%
  gt::cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = everything()
  ) %>%
  gt::sub_missing(
    columns = everything(),
    missing_text = "—"
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(
      size = gt::px(12),
      weight = "bold"
    ),
    locations = gt::cells_column_spanners()
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(align = "center"),
    locations = gt::cells_stubhead()
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_borders(
      sides = "top",
      color = "#D3D3D3",
      weight = gt::px(2)
    ),
    locations = list(
      gt::cells_stub(
        rows = Term == "R²"
      ),
      gt::cells_body(
        rows = Term == "R²"
      )
    )
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_style(
    style = gt::cell_text(align = "center"),
    locations = gt::cells_stub(
      rows = everything()
    )
  ) %>%
  gt::tab_options(
    table.font.names = c("Verdana", "Arial", "sans-serif"),
    table.font.size = gt::px(11),
    column_labels.font.weight = "bold",
    column_labels.border.top.width = gt::px(0),
    column_labels.border.bottom.width = gt::px(1),
    table_body.hlines.width = gt::px(0),
    table.width = gt::px(850)
  )

if(export) {
  gt::gtsave(
    identificationGT,
    filename = "../Tables/identificationTable.png",
    zoom = 3.125,
    expand = 0
  ) 
}

identificationGT
```
